haikus.haiku:
Brave boots tread dawn soft
Echoes of salute rise high
Stars shine on fields bright
Happy #VeteransDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Cone swirls bright cream soft
Cherry sprinkles dance soft rain
Warm syrup hugs tongue
Happy #NationalSundaeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Midnight candle sighs
Pages turn in quiet glow
Thoughts dance like soft light
#HappyBirthdayFyodorDostoevsky from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft candle glow bright
Pages turn with gentle hush
Ink drips like sunrise
#HappyBirthdayKurtVonnegut from @ClamBakeSanta
